verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy's own API docs say a developer can build and test a full API integration using Test mode, which covers the sandbox core of the story. Nothing in the pack shows that test mode mirrors production, or that test cards exist for declines, disputes or other scenarios. missing for 10: documented test cards for success/decline/dispute scenarios, evidence that test mode mirrors production behavior (webhooks, subscriptions, dunning), in-depth test-mode docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and test the entire payment flow in a sandbox or test mode that mirrors production, with test cards for every scenario including declines and disputes

citations.quote: You can build and test a full API integration with Lemon Squeezy using [Test mode](/help/getting-started/test-mode).
